title: Installation Of A Telephone To Det. Serg. E.M. Golders Flat

page_data.en:
Fm. 35
G: 5000-I-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3501.
14. 4. 32.
Special Branch. ALLOCATION
April 12th 19 32

Application of (Rank Initials & Name) Detective Sergeant 118. E.M. Golder.
that the Commissioner of Police will be pleased to Grant the installation
of a telephone at Apartment No 21 of 374 Kiangse Road in view of
the nature of the work of the applicant on the Special Branch.

Signature:— E.M. Golder
D.S. 118

Remarks of Chief Inspector, etc., i/c:— Recommended. The installation of a
telephone in this case would greatly facilitate the work of the Branch.
C.I. Robertson's transfer to Louza leaves a telephone on the credit
side of the Special Branch.
Signature:— H.W. Robertson

Remarks of A. C. (F):— Recommended.

Signature:— J.W. Givens O. i/c Sp. Br.

Date: ____ Commissioner of Police.
page_data.zh:
Fm. 35
G: 5000-I-31

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处。
编号 D 3501。
1932年4月14日。
特别股。分配
1932年4月12日

申请人（警衔、姓名首字母及全名）：警佐 118号 E.M. Golder。
申请事项：鉴于申请人在特别股工作的性质，恳请警务处长批准在江西路374号21室公寓安装电话一部。

签名：— E.M. Golder
警佐 118号

督察长等主管官员意见：— 建议批准。在此情况下安装电话将极大便利该股的工作。罗伯逊（Robertson）督察长调往卢家湾后，特别股的电话配额尚有余额。
签名：— H.W. Robertson

助理警务处长（F组）意见：— 建议批准。

签名：— J.W. Givens 特别股主管

日期：____ 警务处长。
